Game Overview

At its heart, Stick Jump is a hyper-casual game about leap into exhilarating action with StickMan Jumper. Test your reflexes as your fearless stickman springs towards the sky, navigating challenging platforms and dodging obstacles. Master the art of timing and precision to reach new heights, unlock achievements, and chase the thrill of high scores. Can you conquer gravity?
